title: LLMzSzŁ: a comprehensive LLM benchmark for Polish

bias_targets.methodology: Using the Mann-Whitney U test to examine correlations between specific multiple-choice answer codes (e.g., option B) and the model's likelihood of answering incorrectly.

Evaluating and comparing the performance of monolingual (English, Polish) and multilingual LLMs on a Polish national exam benchmark to assess language-centric performance gaps and cross-lingual knowledge transfer.
